items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Louis Russell had a very good band at that time... So I made a few dates with them. And Louis said, well, you can come on in the band as a regular member anytime you like to.

ctx.x: They said, no, you're still originally a member of Chicago.

I couldn't start a regular job on the, on the, on the, and yet I hadn't paid any dues. And so it was just one of those things. I mean everybody tried to straighten it because during that time, Bushbaum was in and he knew me. And he tried his best, but he said, no, you got to stay that waiting period out. Well, Louis Russell had a very good band at that time. Hickey was with him and everything. Well, Louis was just gigging around. So I made a few dates with them. And Louis said, well, you can come on in the band…
Well, we got the end of that story. And that's just something else that you think ought to be told, especially?
